name: Cherry Jam
overview: Six-pitch crack route up the northwest buttress of Table Mountain: a corner that narrows into a fine jam crack, short overhanging bulges, a horizontal chimney under a large roof, then an easy crest finish to the top.
descent: From the register go east some distance, downclimb to a two-bolt ledge, one double-rope rappel, then scramble the gully below the north face
fa: Merle Wheeler, Joanna McComb, Gary Stiles - 10/1970
